scenarios.setup: Fresh process; tiny local Java project; client capabilities fixed.
scenarios.actions: initialize → initialized; query one known symbol; shutdown → exit.
scenarios.correctness: Advertised capabilities match usable features; symbol resolves; shutdown replies and process exits.
scenarios.measurement: Startup → first correct probe, separately from initialize request latency.
scenarios.variants: Fresh server state; reopen with persisted state. Never reuse unsaved buffers across restart.

scenarios.setup: Imported fixture large enough to keep a symbol/reference query outstanding.
scenarios.actions: Send query with ID; send $/cancelRequest for that ID; issue a fresh query.
scenarios.correctness: Exactly one terminal response for the original request; completion may win the race. Subsequent query remains correct.
scenarios.measurement: Correctness only. Do not time notification receipt as cancellation completion.
scenarios.variants: Outstanding request; request already completed.

scenarios.setup: Disk field is String; open buffer changes it to int. Fixed hover marker.
scenarios.actions: didOpen / didChange → hover; save or discard; didClose → reopen and hover.
scenarios.correctness: Hover follows buffer while open and saved disk after close. Latest version wins; no stale type.
scenarios.measurement: Time hover only. Separately record change → first correct hover when measuring freshness.
scenarios.variants: First read; unchanged repeat; unsaved edit; save; discard. Use negotiated sync mode.

scenarios.setup: Closed Extra.java declares Extra; another source references it.
scenarios.actions: Create, modify or delete on disk; didChangeWatchedFiles; search symbols and observe diagnostics.
scenarios.correctness: Created symbol appears; edited symbol replaces old data; deleted symbol disappears and affected reference becomes unresolved.
scenarios.measurement: Disk-change notification → first correct search/diagnostics. Report endpoints separately.
scenarios.variants: Create; modify; delete. Reset fixture before each case.

scenarios.setup: Two tiny roots with distinct types; one main and one test source set.
scenarios.actions: Change roots or imported-project list; getAll; isTestFile; query a root-specific symbol.
scenarios.correctness: Project membership and test classification match fixture; changed membership is visible in follow-up queries.
scenarios.measurement: Membership change → correct inventory/probe; getAll and isTestFile individually.
scenarios.variants: Initial import; add; remove. Workspace-folder and explicit-import routes are alternatives.

scenarios.setup: One module; a source feature and library API that differ between two installed JDK/configurations.
scenarios.actions: Read settings; update setting or JDK; refresh project config when required; read settings and validate.
scenarios.correctness: Requested setting/JDK is reported; acceptance and diagnostics change with the selected compiler environment.
scenarios.measurement: Update → correct settings/diagnostics; time individual get/update requests separately.
scenarios.variants: No change; compiler-setting change; JDK switch. Deprecated single-project refresh is alias coverage only.

scenarios.setup: One module; main/test roots; local dependency JAR versions A/B expose different methods.
scenarios.actions: Get/list paths; add/remove source root or updateClassPaths; query affected symbol/completion.
scenarios.correctness: Paths, scope and method set match chosen inputs; removed roots/dependencies no longer contribute.
scenarios.measurement: Each path request; change → correct query measured separately.
scenarios.variants: Main vs test scope; add/remove source root; JAR A → B. One change per case.

scenarios.setup: One local JAR; matching sources ZIP with a unique comment. Definition points into that JAR.
scenarios.actions: Resolve attachment; fetch class content; attach sources; fetch again. Exercise each content route independently.
scenarios.correctness: Content represents the correct class; attached source contains the known comment; attachment metadata matches.
scenarios.measurement: Each content/attachment request separately; first fetch and unchanged repeat.
scenarios.variants: No attachment; matching attachment; updated attachment. Do not compare decompiler text byte-for-byte.

scenarios.setup: Two modules; valid saved sources; dependency artifacts already local.
scenarios.actions: buildWorkspace or buildProjects; introduce a saved error, rebuild; fix and rebuild.
scenarios.correctness: Returned build status and diagnostics agree; selected-scope build affects intended projects.
scenarios.measurement: Build request → result; report full and incremental builds separately.
scenarios.variants: Full; unchanged incremental; changed source; compile error. Reset between independent cases.

scenarios.setup: Tiny configured protobuf project; generator and artifacts local; generated output removed.
scenarios.actions: java.protobuf.generateSources; inspect generated files; query a generated type.
scenarios.correctness: Expected type is generated and usable; repeat does not duplicate declarations.
scenarios.measurement: Generation command → completion; generated-type readiness reported separately.
scenarios.variants: First generation; unchanged repeat. Only when protobuf capability is in scope.

scenarios.setup: Customer has name() and number(); client code contains customer.n at a marked cursor.
scenarios.actions: completion; resolve one returned item; apply its edits; notify selection when offered.
scenarios.correctness: Expected methods are offered; replacement/import edits are valid; resolved docs belong to selected item.
scenarios.measurement: completion and completionItem/resolve individually; no combined total.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; narrower prefix; receiver-method edit. Reset stale candidates after edits.

scenarios.family: Inspect type, docs and call arguments
scenarios.setup: Documented overloaded method; call with two arguments and fixed cursor markers.
scenarios.actions: hover at symbol; signatureHelp inside call. Each is an independent request.
scenarios.correctness: Hover has correct type/signature/docs; signature help identifies valid overload and active argument.
scenarios.measurement: Time each request separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; declaration/signature edit; cursor moves to next argument.

scenarios.setup: Interface, implementation and caller; explicit types; overloads; unrelated same-name method; one stack frame.
scenarios.actions: At fixed markers, request declaration / definition / typeDefinition / implementation / findLinks / name / stack URI.
scenarios.correctness: Returned target identities and ranges match fixture markers; name is qualified; stack lookup returns correct URI.
scenarios.measurement: Each navigation request or command separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; target declaration moved in source. Requests are alternative probes, not a pipeline.

scenarios.family: Find uses of the right symbol
scenarios.setup: Two files; known declaration, reads/writes and call sites; unrelated same-name symbol.
scenarios.actions: references with includeDeclaration on/off; documentHighlight at the same symbol.
scenarios.correctness: Reference location set is exact; declaration flag respected; highlights stay within document; homonym excluded.
scenarios.measurement: references and documentHighlight separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; add/remove one use in an open buffer.

scenarios.setup: Two projects with distinct and shared names; nested type; inherited member; one dependency type.
scenarios.actions: workspace/symbol or java/searchSymbols; resolve returned symbol; request normal/extended document outline.
scenarios.correctness: Names, kinds and ranges match fixture; project/source/limit filters respected; extended outline includes inherited members.
scenarios.measurement: Each search, resolve or outline request separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; new/renamed declaration. Apply only relevant filters to each endpoint.

scenarios.setup: A calls B twice; B calls C; unrelated D has the same method name.
scenarios.actions: prepareCallHierarchy at B; incomingCalls and outgoingCalls using returned item.
scenarios.correctness: Incoming A and outgoing C are correct; both A call-site ranges present; unrelated D excluded.
scenarios.measurement: Prepare and each expansion separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; add/remove one call. Prepare a fresh item after mutation.

scenarios.setup: Interface I; Base implements I; Child extends Base; unrelated type U.
scenarios.actions: prepareTypeHierarchy; supertypes/subtypes. Run legacy open/resolve commands only as compatibility alternatives.
scenarios.correctness: Direct parent/child sets are correct; no unrelated types; legacy direction/depth respected.
scenarios.measurement: Prepare and each expansion separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; change Child's parent. Re-prepare after edits.

scenarios.setup: Small file with type, field, local, method call and parameter-name hint sites; settings fixed.
scenarios.actions: semanticTokens/full; inlayHint for a requested range.
scenarios.correctness: Decoded tokens match negotiated legend and valid source spans; expected hints appear inside requested range.
scenarios.measurement: Each request separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; source edit shifting spans. Assert semantic categories, not editor colours.

scenarios.setup: Nested class/method/block with comments and multiline expressions.
scenarios.actions: foldingRange; selectionRange at marked expression.
scenarios.correctness: Folds have valid boundaries; selection chain nests outward and contains the cursor.
scenarios.measurement: Each request separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; edit that shifts line numbers.

scenarios.setup: Reference code lenses enabled; method has a known number of uses.
scenarios.actions: codeLens; resolve selected returned lens; change reference count and request again.
scenarios.correctness: Lens points to correct declaration; resolved label/command agrees with actual reference locations.
scenarios.measurement: codeLens and codeLens/resolve separately.
scenarios.variants: First; unchanged repeat; added/removed use. Resolve only current lens objects.

scenarios.setup: Poorly spaced Java file; fixed formatter profile; marked selection and supported trigger.
scenarios.actions: Whole-file, range, on-type or string formatting; apply returned edits/text to a scratch copy.
scenarios.correctness: Output matches chosen profile and preserves code; range edits respect scope; second formatting is stable.
scenarios.measurement: Each formatter route separately.
scenarios.variants: Whole file; selection; on-type; raw string. Reset fixture for each route.

scenarios.setup: Missing/unused imports; one configured cleanup; save actions fixed; unambiguous import target.
scenarios.actions: organizeImports or cleanup or willSaveWaitUntil; apply edits and synchronize buffer.
scenarios.correctness: Expected import/cleanup change occurs; unrelated code untouched; resulting source valid; repeat has no further change.
scenarios.measurement: Each edit-producing request separately; apply/sync outside timing.
scenarios.variants: Imports; manual cleanup; pre-save route. Folder/project organize-imports is a scope variant.

scenarios.setup: Destination file and selection; text requiring escaping or an import; package-qualified pasted class.
scenarios.actions: handlePasteEvent; separately resolveText or smartSemicolonDetection.
scenarios.correctness: Paste text/additional edits preserve intended content; suggested file path matches type/package; semicolon location valid.
scenarios.measurement: Each command separately.
scenarios.variants: String paste; code paste needing import; file-path suggestion; semicolon placement. Feature settings fixed.

scenarios.family: Rename a symbol or source file
scenarios.setup: Public class plus two callers and an unrelated same-name local; fixed target marker.
scenarios.actions: prepareRename → rename; separately willRenameFiles; apply returned edits in scratch workspace.
scenarios.correctness: All intended declarations/uses/file operations updated; unrelated names untouched; edited project remains valid.
scenarios.measurement: Prepare, rename and file-rename preparation separately; application/verification untimed.
scenarios.variants: Symbol name; file/folder move; invalid rename position. Reset before each variant.

scenarios.family: Discover and apply a code action
scenarios.setup: One unresolved import for a quick fix; one extractable expression; exact selection and diagnostic.
scenarios.actions: codeAction → select by kind/behaviour → resolve if deferred → apply edit or execute returned command.
scenarios.correctness: Applicable action offered; resolved operation fixes selected problem or preserves refactored behaviour; no unrelated edits.
scenarios.measurement: Discovery and resolve/command separately; returned edit verified outside timing.
scenarios.variants: Quick fix; simple refactor; no applicable action. Do not depend on display-title wording.

scenarios.setup: Small class with callers; movable member; extractable interface; expected after-source per operation.
scenarios.actions: Request selection/signature/destination/interface choices; submit chosen parameters to getRefactorEdit or move.
scenarios.correctness: Choices are valid; chosen names/parameters/destination reflected in edit; callers updated; resulting sources compile.
scenarios.measurement: Each preparation and edit-generation request separately.
scenarios.variants: Extract selection; change signature; move; extract interface. Independent cases sharing one family.

scenarios.setup: Class with two fields, inherited methods, delegate field and constructor choices; scratch copy per operation.
scenarios.actions: Check/list eligible members → select a subset → matching generation request; apply edit. Module-info route separately.
scenarios.correctness: Only selected members generated; signatures/bodies valid; existing-member status accurate; module-info URI identifies created file.
scenarios.measurement: Preparation and generation separately; edited-source validation untimed.
scenarios.variants: Overrides; equals/hashCode; toString; accessors; constructors; delegates; module-info. One generator per case.

scenarios.setup: Caller/provider pair; known type error; versioned buffer; separate loose-file case.
scenarios.actions: Open/change file or java/validateDocument; capture publishDiagnostics; fix error; test loose-file refresh mode.
scenarios.correctness: Problem belongs to correct file/range and current content; fix clears it; provider API edit updates caller; scope mode respected.
scenarios.measurement: Trigger → matching diagnostic publication. Notifications have no response latency.
scenarios.variants: Valid; local error; fix; provider-signature edit; syntax-only/full loose-file mode.

guideCellValues.A2: API catalogue = supplied reference. Scenarios = proposed tests. No benchmarks have been run.

guideCellValues.A3: Colours identify domains consistently across sheets. Filter by domain or scenario ID; frozen headers remain visible.

guideCellValues.F6: Variants are independent cases, not one giant script. Choose only variants listed; do not generate every possible combination.

guideCellValues.F7: Project import, fixture reset and buffer sync are setup unless the timing column explicitly measures that transition.

guideCellValues.F8: Start when request is sent; stop on its response. Assert output separately; a fast wrong answer is a failed test.

guideCellValues.F9: For notifications, start at the stated trigger; stop at the first matching correct result/publication. Use version and fixture markers, not sleeps.

guideCellValues.F10: First = first target call after defined setup, not machine-cold. Repeat = same state. Changed = one specified input change.

guideCellValues.F11: SES-01 distinguishes fresh server state from persisted reopen. Dependency/JDK caches held fixed; no cold×warm×restart cross-product.

guideCellValues.F12: Record pass/fail plus per-endpoint median and p95 latency. Allocation bytes/op only when measurable; report process peak RSS separately.

guideCellValues.F13: Assert known fixture identities, ranges and effects. Do not require identical JSON, ranking, IDs, message wording or decompiled text.

guideCellValues.F14: R: request/reply. N: notification/no direct reply. C: command through workspace/executeCommand. Last API domain reverses direction.

guideCellValues.F15: Resolve/expand only items returned in the same case; get fresh items after edits where specified.

guideCellValues.F16: Capture, reply or dispatch as part of relevant cases. Logs, status and progress are not additional performance scenarios.

guideCellValues.F17: Trace no-op, troubleshooting, bundle reload and Gradle wrapper upgrade retained in catalogue; deliberately no padded scenarios.

guideCellValues.F18: 28 proposed families cover the language/project behaviours in this inventory. Optional extension APIs, debugging and editor UI automation are not added.

guideCellValues.F19: Input: JDTLS_API_Table.md supplied in this conversation. Commit b1fccde15719a4d4d848422489dd17fff1311627. Existing source links retained; not freshly reverified.

guideCellValues.A23: Reference-only & harness-only items — retained, not hidden

guideCellValues.C24: Reference only: accepted no-op in supplied snapshot; no useful performance scenario.

guideCellValues.C25: Reference only: administrative report; retain contract, no standalone benchmark.

guideCellValues.C26: Reference only: optional extension management; no extension-specific fixtures added.

guideCellValues.C27: Reference only: wrapper administration; deliberately outside the minimal language-API scenarios.

guideCellValues.C28: Harness support: capture payload and offered actions when emitted; no standalone benchmark.

guideCellValues.C29: Harness support: capture only when enabled; exclude telemetry count/timing from scores.

guideCellValues.C30: Harness support: capture logs; no exact message-text or throughput target.

guideCellValues.C31: Harness support: capture severity and text when emitted.

guideCellValues.C32: Harness support: return a deterministic offered choice or null.

guideCellValues.C33: Harness support: dispatch known client command notifications; record unexpected IDs.
